thread:
Priya: FYI we rolled out the new routing policy for /v1/chat last night. Dashboards show a p99 jump only on the endpoint view. p50/p95 stable. raw request logs don't reflect the same tail. anyone looked into attribution?
Diego: saw that spike at 03:10 UTC. It was noisy in us-west. Could be a sampling source mismatch after the routing policy update.
Sam: is the dashboard percentiles coming from the ingestion rollups or from query-time sampling?
Priya: ingestion. We changed the sampler to resolve route at the edge but the ingest worker still tags samples with pre-resolve origin.
Nora: so the rollups are labeled by pre-resolve origin, but the UI groups by resolved endpoint? that would create a misleading p99 if heavy-tail clients were re-routed.
Ben: exactly. If high-tail traffic moved to the new route but labels stayed old, rollup merge mixes apples+oranges. I think this is a tag alignment bug.
ingest-bot: Ingest worker deployed: tag=route-attr-fix candidate=2025-11-07T02:58:47Z
Diego: short repro: send 500 requests with header X-Route-FORCE: new-route; compare dashboard rollup vs raw events.
Priya: ran repro on staging: events p99=240ms, dashboard p99=680ms. The top 1% in dashboard map to callers that were actually routed to new-route.
Sam: immediate mitigation: annotate the dashboard with the rollout window and make the alert suppression threshold wider for the affected view.
Nora: Q for UX: should the console show which attribution model was used for the chart? e.g., "attributed_by: pre-resolve origin" vs "attributed_by: resolved-route".
Ben: yes. Also a toggle that allows users to switch attribution for percentiles would be helpful for debugging.
Priya: long-term, ingestion should write both tags: sample_origin and resolved_route, and rollups should prefer resolved_route for endpoint views.
Diego: low-risk patch: copy resolved_route into `metric.route` on ingest so existing dashboards pick it up. I'll open a PR.
Sam: product input: we should avoid adding too many toggles. Maybe expose the attribution info in an info flyout and keep a single canonical mode that matches the API semantics.
Nora: agreed. For now, doc the difference in the dashboard help text and put a banner during the rollout.
Ben: action list: (1) Diego PR to set metric.route to resolved_route; (2) Priya add dashboard banner & suppress pager for 24h; (3) Sam work with Product on attribution UX copy; (4) Nora add a diagnostic link that runs the 500-request comparison and returns both p99s.
Priya: I'm on (2) and will schedule the banner. Diego, assign the PR to me for quick review.
Diego: PR opened #4521. Tagging Priya & Ben.
Sam: thanks everyone. this one was a good catch before we punched the on-call paging. :thumbsup:
